description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget called PaymentFragment, which represents a payment screen with various payment options such as Paytm, Mobikwik, and Google Pay. It includes UI components, deep-link launching functionality, and a payment confirmation dialog.

classes.name: PaymentFragment
classes.description: A stateless widget that builds a payment options UI with deep-link integrations and a confirmation dialog.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the payment screen, including payment options list and a 'Pay' button.

methods.name: _buildPaymentTile
methods.description: Helper method to build individual payment method tiles with icon, name, and tap behavior.

methods.name: _launchApp
methods.description: Attempts to launch an external application via a URL scheme; shows a fallback message if the app is not installed or launch fails.

methods.name: _showPaymentDialog
methods.description: Displays a confirmation dialog for completing the payment, providing 'Yes' and 'No' options.
